title: CIVIL AND CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING MATERIALS
description: Classify attributes and quantify properties of civil and construction engineering materials including portland cement concrete, asphalt concrete, wood, and metals. Implement and interpret data from  standard laboratory material testing methods.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ENGR 213 or 213H.
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 213 and ENGR 213H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MWF 9am-9:50am in KEAR 312 - Kearney Hall 312 (9/23 to 12/4)
